scopeLimits: 143 valid distinct JUPEM Penang cadastral-reference lots verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged George Town metropolitan WUP locator. The Forestry government GIS host supplies native UPI identity and FID transport IDs; variable-length native UPI strings are preserved without padding, truncation or substitution. Complete object-ID manifests, forced three-row geometry pages (56 parcels over 19 pages), all 143 fresh native-ID reads, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed in 80 requests. Independent metric EPSG:32647 GEOS found all geometries valid and distinct, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The missing TLS intermediate is supplied from the official GlobalSign CA with certificate and hostname verification enabled for every runtime request; no runtime verification bypass is used. The publisher credits JUPEM 2020 and declares source CRS as ArcGIS WKID 102062; explicit EPSG:4326 output is retained unchanged. This is bounded metropolitan reference geometry, without claims of George Town municipal-only or citywide completeness, legal title, currentness, survey accuracy or long-term key continuity.
name: George Town
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official Penang Timur Laut District and Land Office identifies a local land-registration unit in George Town. The government Forestry-hosted JUPEM Penang cadastral layer returns intact public parcels at the unchanged metropolitan locator. This establishes local land registry and bounded nearby cadastral geometry, without municipal-only or citywide coverage claims.
remainingUncertainty: Completeness and coverage beyond the one point; whether the source layer is current throughout the district; reuse license/terms and native UPI stability.
nextStep: Retain point/native-id lookup as a candidate only; root should review bounded coverage and validity, and obtain the official reuse terms before runtime enablement.

executedQueries.query: Penang GeoHub lot kadaster Pulau Pinang peta parcel George Town lot UPI
executedQueries.scope: Confirm Penang/George Town local land registry and inspect anonymous cadastral polygon geometry at WUP point.
executedQueries.result: Penang GeoHub is a public state geospatial platform; its public ArcGIS cadastral lot services expose Polygon Feature Layers with query support and safe parcel keys. Official GIS metadata credits JUPEM and identifies Penang cadastral lots. A bounded exact point query at the supplied George Town coordinate returned one full Polygon in requested EPSG:4326 with only MUKIM, PA, LOT, UPI and KELUASAN fields. The separate official Timur Laut District and Land Office provides local land registration services in KOMTAR, George Town.

executedQueries.scope: Verify city identity, local registration authority, and full polygon response contract.
executedQueries.result: Penang GeoHub states it offers public geospatial applications and open data; the official Penang layer metadata identifies cadastral lot polygons and query operations. The exact WUP point intersects one complete lot polygon. The layer’s source CRS is EPSG:102062; the request explicitly declared the input point as EPSG:4326 and requested EPSG:4326 output.

officialSources.observation: Official Penang GeoHub describes public geospatial applications and open geospatial data; it gives its state geospatial-management contact in George Town.
Official PEGIS ArcGIS metadata exposes a `Maklumat Lot` Polygon Feature Layer with JSON/GeoJSON/PBF query formats, pagination, and parcel-key fields (lot, UPI, area, administrative locality).

Official Malaysian forestry GIS lists Penang `Lot Kadaster` as a polygon feature layer, credits JUPEM 2020 and exposes MUKIM, PA, LOT, UPI and KELUASAN fields; source spatial reference is EPSG:102062.
Official Penang PgLAND land-administration portal lists the Timur Laut District and Land Office, including a land-registration unit, at KOMTAR, 10000 Pulau Pinang (George Town).
Official Department of Survey and Mapping Malaysia lists MyLot as an online land-lot location and boundary application and eKadaster as its cadastral information service.
